title: 2BR Music Ranch/6 mi to Downtown, Large Yard
description:
Stylish Desert Rose Music City 2-bedroom house with free parking and pet friendly. 10-15 minutes from the airport, and 10-15 minutes from downtown Nashville, this is a perfect crash pad for business travelers, couples and small families.  Also, features huge 1/2 acre fully fenced in yard for your furry critters to explore.

The space
We are proud to say this property is thoroughly cleaned and disinfected after each stay according to the protocols set forth by the CDC. 

This spot was both thoughtfully and functionally designed. 

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Free Parking

You will have the entire home during your stay.  

BACKYARD: 
-fully fenced-in and includes chairs, a picnic table, string lights, and a fire pit.  

PARKING: 
Two car carport can accommodate one vehicle(owner's vehicle will be parked under the carport).  You may park one additional car behind your vehicle in the driveway during your stay. 2 cars max.

ROOMS: 
Each room is equipped with a charging station and sound machines with night lights as well as blackout curtains.

Environmental and Eco-friendly house with natural products.

KID-FRIENDLY: 

✔ Pac N Play
✔ High Chair
✔ Baby bathtub
✔ booster seat
✔ step stool plus books and games for the kids
✔ outdoor play set/swing

*Please note: During the winter all live cacti are inside the house(not baby safe).  Access to the backyard is through the driveway gate(our backdoor is not accessible to guests)

Guest access
We leave one room off the kitchen locked to store personal items and supplies. Access to the backyard is thru the driveway gate.(back door not accessible to guests)

Other things to note
Owner suburban will be parked under the carport during your stay(owner will not be present).
